categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/net.cpp to alter P2P listen socket options on Windows and carries the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Prevents local port hijacking of P2P listen sockets on Windows. As noted in commit c6971fd610 and Microsoft Winsock documentation, using SO_REUSEADDR allows other processes under the same user account to bind to the port and intercept incoming P2P connections unless SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE is specified.
